senses.gloss: m. (מְתַן; cmp. מְשִׁיחָא II. fr. מְשַׁח) cord, strap.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 89a">B. Bath. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>מיתנא</he> Rashb. (ed. <cite ref="M03087"><he>מִתְנָה</he></cite>, h. form) the cord of the scales.

<cite ref="Menachot 35b:1">Men. 35ᵇ</cite> top <he>כל הוכי דכי מיתלי</he> (<cite ref="B00537"><he>ביה</he></cite>) <he>במת׳ וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>במו׳</he>; Ms. R. 2 <he>במי׳</he>) whenever it is lifted up by its strap and it (the capsule of the T’fillin) follows after it (the strap not breaking).
<cite ref="Eruvin 34a:6">Erub. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>לַיְתֵיה בכוותא ומ׳</he> let him bring it down through the window (of the tower) and with a string.
<cite ref="Shabbat 51b:16">Sabb. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>סגי לה במי׳ בעלמא</he> (Ms. M. <he>במיתגא</he>, incorr.) a mere string would have been sufficient for controlling the animal.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 113b:8">B. Mets. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן דאסר מי׳ דכיתנא וכ׳</he> he who ties a rope of moist flax around his loins.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:1:4">Y. Ned. III., beg. 37ᵈ</cite> <cite ref="M03086"><he>מו׳</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="H00156"><he>חֲגַר</he> I</cite>; a. e.
